{{Quote|My mother was a botanist on Raysho. She used to procure bulbs for Dok's gardens.|A [[Gender|female]] [[Resistance]] member, to [[Julen Rakab]]|<ref name="A Crash of Fate">''[[A Crash of Fate]]''</ref>}}
'''Raysho'''<ref name="Graphics" /> was one of five [[planet]]s<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> that [[orbit]]ed the [[Hosnian's sun|same sun]], making up the [[Hosnian system]], in the [[Core Worlds|Core]] region of [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Graphics" /> The [[Star system|system]], including Raysho, was [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destroyed]] by the [[First Order]]<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref>
